head: Starlink price increase: surge pricing raises some US plans 10-20%
dek: SpaceX emailed Starlink customers across the US that Residential prices are going up 10% to 20% in busy areas, saying it needs to manage supply and demand. The Residential Max plan goes from $130 to $156 a month at 20%.
details: Starlink's dynamic pricing appears to have spread from the Midwest to the whole US. Starlink says prices may change as more people in an area use the service.
where: US, Starlink Residential plans in affected areas
means: If you have Starlink at home, check your email: your monthly bill may rise.
todo: Read Starlink's email for your new price, and compare other internet options in your area before it takes effect.
